claims.text: GDACS report 'Overall Orange Flood in China from 22 Aug 2026 01:00 UTC to 26 Aug 2026 01:00 UTC' (event FL 1104123, GLIDE FL-2026-000166-CHN): location Fujian Province, China; 1 death and 87,168 displaced; alert text states heavy rain from 24 August 2026 caused the flooding, assessed as having 'a medium humanitarian impact based on the magnitude, exposed population and vulnerability.'

description: Heavy rain beginning 24 August 2026 caused flooding across Fujian Province on China's southeastern coast, triggering a GDACS Orange flood alert. GDACS's episode report, covering 22-26 August 2026, records 1 death and 87,168 people displaced by the flooding. The event is a distinct, later episode from the early-August landfall of Typhoon Dolphin elsewhere on China's eastern seaboard, which is tracked separately.

impact.summary: GDACS's flood report for Fujian Province (event FL 1104123, GLIDE FL-2026-000166-CHN), covering 22-26 August 2026, records 1 death and 87,168 people displaced under an Orange alert for medium humanitarian impact, attributing the flooding to heavy rain beginning 24 August 2026.

name: Fujian Floods, China
